type.basis: Evidence specimen; no description of its sound was found, so every code is drafted.

context.text: Chantelle Fiddy ('Hitting the Target', 25 Oct 2004; a version also ran in Touch magazine) lists Poltergeist/Runaway and 'the Poltergeist Remix by Terror Danger' [sic] among Aim High releases then available.

The Aim High Vol. 2 press release posted by Fiddy (7 Jan 2005) gives Aim High's catalogue: AIM001 'Pick Yourself Up', AIM002 'Poltergeist', AIM003 'Chosen One' feat. Riko, AIM004 'Poltergeist Rmx' by Terror Danjah, AIM005 'STDS' feat. OT Crew.
DJ Target (Darren Joseph) is an East London grime producer, formerly of Pay As U Go, who formed Roll Deep with Wiley, Breeze and Flow Dan after PAUG broke up.
